about.intro: I have 2+ years of experience building and maintaining web applications for enterprise clients in banking, pharmaceutical and government. I work across the stack with JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Vue.js, Node.js and SQL, and I build and deploy my own full-stack projects outside of work. I hold a B.A. in Computer Science (Magna Cum Laude) and a Full Stack Development certificate from the University of Pennsylvania, and I'm bilingual in English and Spanish.

points: Built and maintained frontend interfaces for enterprise clients in banking, pharmaceutical and government sectors using Vue.js, PHP and JavaScript.
Developed SQL queries and data pipelines to extract, transform and deliver reporting data for a banking client processing 300K+ loan cases.
Created interactive Power BI dashboards that let clients monitor automation progress themselves, reducing support inquiries and improving transparency.
Diagnosed and resolved production bugs across Vue.js and PHP codebases, improving application stability and user experience.
Led the handoff and on-schedule production deployment of an Automation Anywhere bot following a team reassignment.
Collaborated with stakeholders to gather requirements, define technical scope and align deliverables using Jira and Bitbucket.
Handled 100+ customer inquiries per shift in a high-volume retail environment; earned a Certificate of Achievement for the highest loyalty program enrollment in the store.

code-like-a-dog.title: Do You Code Like a Dog?
code-like-a-dog.description: Interactive developer personality quiz that matches coding habits to 9 dog breed archetypes. Built with functional components, props, conditional rendering and client-side routing. Features URL-based result sharing and copy-to-clipboard.

raiz-rizada.title: Raíz Rizada — Curly Hair Weather App
raiz-rizada.description: Weather app that calculates a personalized curl forecast from real-time humidity and temperature. Includes error handling, keyboard support and porosity-tailored recommendations.

stripe-dashboard.title: Stripe API Dashboard
stripe-dashboard.description: ETL pipeline that connects to the Stripe API to extract, transform and report transaction data, now expanding with a React dashboard for visual reporting.
